basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old civil engineer living in Seattle, WA. I have a passion for fantasy football and recently got into the Dynasty format. When I'm not working on structural designs or browsing Reddit, I love spending time with my playful Goldendoodle named Charlie. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. Single and loving the freedom to focus on my career and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in civil engineering and have been working in the field for about 5 years. My knowledge of fantasy football is mostly self-taught, with lots of research and participation in various leagues. I'm still learning the ropes of the Dynasty format.
